provenance_note: All 1747 checks are recomputed by the reference; corrections and specification changes are recorded in the reference file.
reference: Independent python reference written by a second agent from a method specification and the case files only, without access to the page code: a node-head Newton solver posed as a convex minimisation with exact per-component inversion, cross-checked by a Todini-Pilati global-gradient solver (agreement 1e-10 relative or better) and by closed forms or scalar roots on 17 simple layouts (1e-12 or better). Corrections and specification changes are recorded in the reference file. Every case input is stored in benchmarks/hydraulicnetwork.reference.json.
reference_citations: H. Cross, Analysis of Flow in Networks of Conduits or Conductors, Univ. of Illinois Eng. Exp. Station Bulletin 286 (1936) — loop-correction method.

P.K. Swamee & A.K. Jain, Explicit equations for pipe-flow problems, ASCE J. Hydraulics Div. 102(5) (1976) 657-664 — f = 0.25/[log10(eps/(3.7 D) + 5.74/Re^0.9)]^2, stated for 1e-6 <= eps/D <= 1e-2 and 5e3 <= Re <= 1e8.
C.F. Colebrook, J. Inst. Civ. Eng. 11 (1939) 133-156 — used only to quantify the Swamee-Jain scatter.
Hagen-Poiseuille laminar closed form f = 64/Re — derived, used to grade the laminar branch.
IEC 60534-2-1 / metric Kv definition: Q[m3/h] = Kv sqrt(dp[bar]/SG).
Affinity law H ~ n^2 for the two-point quadratic pump curve.

tolerance.en: Pass if |page - reference| <= max(1e-6 x |reference|, a small absolute floor per quantity), widened per key to twice the first-order error the page's convergence gate (scaled residual 2e-9) can leave; status, refusal kind, warnings and monotone orderings exact (warnings on a regime threshold accept either side, as round-off decides them).
tolerance.uk: Перевірку пройдено, якщо |сторінка - еталон| <= max(1e-6 x |еталон|, невеликий абсолютний нижній поріг для кожної величини), розширений для кожного ключа до подвоєної похибки першого порядку, яку може залишити критерій збіжності сторінки (масштабований залишок 2e-9); статус, вид відхилення, попередження й монотонні впорядкування — точно (попередження на порозі режиму приймають будь-який бік, оскільки їх вирішує похибка округлення).
tolerance.de: Bestanden, wenn |Seite - Referenz| <= max(1e-6 x |Referenz|, eine kleine absolute Untergrenze je Größe), je Schlüssel erweitert auf das Doppelte des Fehlers erster Ordnung, den das Konvergenzkriterium der Seite (skaliertes Residuum 2e-9) hinterlassen kann; Status, Abweisungsart, Warnungen und monotone Reihenfolgen exakt (Warnungen an einer Regimegrenze akzeptieren beide Seiten, da Rundungsfehler über sie entscheiden).
tolerance.nl: Geslaagd als |pagina - referentie| <= max(1e-6 x |referentie|, een kleine absolute ondergrens per grootheid), per sleutel verruimd tot tweemaal de eersteordefout die het convergentiecriterium van de pagina (geschaald residu 2e-9) kan laten; status, soort weigering, waarschuwingen en monotone volgordes exact (waarschuwingen op een regimegrens aanvaarden beide zijden, omdat afrondingsfouten erover beslissen).
tolerance.fr: Réussi si |page - référence| <= max(1e-6 x |référence|, un petit plancher absolu par grandeur), élargi par clé au double de l'erreur du premier ordre que le critère de convergence de la page (résidu mis à l'échelle 2e-9) peut laisser ; statut, type de refus, avertissements et ordres monotones exacts (les avertissements sur un seuil de régime acceptent l'un ou l'autre côté, car les erreurs d'arrondi en décident).
tolerance.es: Pasa si |página - referencia| <= max(1e-6 x |referencia|, un pequeño suelo absoluto por magnitud), ampliado por clave al doble del error de primer orden que puede dejar el criterio de convergencia de la página (residuo escalado 2e-9); estado, tipo de rechazo, advertencias y ordenaciones monótonas exactos (las advertencias en un umbral de régimen aceptan cualquiera de los dos lados, ya que el redondeo las decide).
tolerance.pl: Zaliczone, jeśli |strona - wzorzec| <= max(1e-6 x |wzorzec|, mały bezwzględny próg dolny dla każdej wielkości), poszerzone dla każdego klucza do dwukrotności błędu pierwszego rzędu, jaki może pozostawić kryterium zbieżności strony (skalowane residuum 2e-9); status, rodzaj odrzucenia, ostrzeżenia i monotoniczne uporządkowania dokładnie (ostrzeżenia na progu reżimu akceptują dowolną stronę, ponieważ rozstrzyga o nich błąd zaokrąglenia).

tolerance_detail.rule: pass if |page - expected| <= max(rel * |expected|, abs) for the key family, or <= case.tolerance_override_abs[key] when that is given (page-gate bound, A9)

flow_*.why: gate 2e-9 on scaled residuals moves flows by O(1e-9) relative in well-conditioned cases; 1e-6 leaves 1000x margin; per-key override where the gate allows more

head_loss_*.why: head-loss error = h'(q) dq, same order as flow error times the law exponent (<= 3)

pump_head_*.why: parabola evaluated at q, error 2 a q dq

head_across_*.why: difference of two HGLs, each bounded by the energy residual gate 2e-9 h_scale

hgl_*.why: 2e-9 h_scale <= 1e-6 m for h_scale up to 500 m

pressure_*.why: rho g/1000 x HGL tolerance (~1e-5 kPa per 1e-6 m)

boundary_*.why: sum of incident flows, continuity gate

Re_*.why: vD/nu, same relative error as flow

f_*.why: df/dRe x dRe is below 1e-6 relative except across the 2000-4000 blend where the override applies

tolerance_detail.outcome, message_kind, notification_kind: exact match (warnings: kinds and component id lists, order as section 9, threshold ties per the section 9 tie rule)
tolerance_detail.monotone: strict ordering of the throttle sequence as stated in the throttle cases

process: Phase 1: a driver agent wrote the stored case inputs, the method specification and the page driver, and wrote no expected values. Phase 2: a second agent wrote the reference from the case inputs and the specification only, without access to the page code. Phase 3: the page outputs were graded against the reference with the reference tolerances unchanged; disputed points were adjudicated against the specification and every correction is recorded in the reference file.

spec change R2 (method.md rev 2026-10-15, section 9 item 2 / A1): eps/D < 1e-6 (incl. eps = 0) is warned outside_swamee_jain_range; spec change R4 (method.md rev 2026-10-15, section 9 / A3): tie rule at Re 2000/4000/5e3/1e8 and eps/D 1e-6/1e-2 (1e-7 relative)

spec_changes.summary: loadFactor and speedFactor are applied exactly as entered or imported; the integer-percent rounding on import is removed. The range checks (0-150 %, 40-120 %) are unchanged.
The Swamee-Jain range warning also lists pipes with eps/D < 1e-6, including eps = 0; the warning text states the box as 5e3<=Re<=1e8, 1e-6<=eps/D<=1e-2.
An import refusal is notified with the error style (kind err); an accepted import with the success style (kind ok). Graded as notification_kind.

Warning classification tie rule: a solved Re (or eps/D) within 1e-7 relative of 2000, 4000, 5e3, 1e8 (1e-6, 1e-2) is classified as the threshold value; Re = 2000 laminar, Re = 4000 Swamee-Jain branch (listed as outside the box), Re = 5e3, 1e8 and eps/D = 1e-6, 1e-2 inside the closed box. The friction law is unchanged.

reference_decisions.ambiguity: A1 lower eps/D bound of the Swamee-Jain box (resolved by R2)
reference_decisions.decision: Per method.md rev 2026-10-15: a turbulent pipe (Re >= 4000) with eps/D < 1e-6, including eps = 0, is warned outside_swamee_jain_range; eps/D = 1e-6 itself is inside.
reference_decisions.why: Follows the revised section 9. concern (kept, now about the warning rather than the page text): below eps/D = 1e-6 Swamee-Jain tends to its smooth-pipe limit and stays within 0.3 % of Colebrook here (crosscheck.swamee_jain_vs_colebrook: sj_eps_bounds S1/S2, sj_laminar_blend_range S16/S17), better than inside the box near eps/D = 1e-2 (up to 2.8 %). The warning on smooth pipes therefore flags no loss of accuracy; it is a statement about the fitted range only.

reference_decisions.ambiguity: A2 non-integer analysis factors (resolved by R1)
reference_decisions.decision: Per method.md rev 2026-10-15: loadFactor and speedFactor applied exactly as written (87.6 %, 62.5 %, 0.5 %, 97.5 %, 87.6 % speed). The 2026-10-11 rounding to 88 % is reverted.
reference_decisions.why: The factor is a continuous multiplier of demand (and of pump speed through the affinity law); nothing in hydraulics quantises it. The earlier concern about silent rounding is closed by R1.

reference_decisions.ambiguity: A3 regime boundaries (resolved by R4 tie rule)
reference_decisions.decision: Warnings classify on the solved Re, taken as the threshold when within 1e-7 relative of 2000, 4000, 5e3 or 1e8 (eps/D likewise at 1e-6 and 1e-2). Re = 2000 laminar (not listed), Re = 4000 Swamee-Jain branch (listed outside the box, 4000 < 5e3), Re = 5e3, 1e8, eps/D = 1e-6, 1e-2 inside the closed box. The friction factor uses the solved Re unchanged. On tree cases the Re fed to the rule is evaluated in rational arithmetic of the stored demands (agrees with the float Re of the solved flow to ~1e-15).
reference_decisions.why: Follows the revised section 9. The 1e-7 window covers the worst-case Re error the page stopping rule (2e-9 on scaled residuals, propagated through |J^-1|) allows on every tie pipe: 2e-9 to 4e-8 relative (sj_grid_re_5e3_1e5 S1-S5 4e-8, sj_laminar_blend_range S6 1e-8 / S12 5e-9, sj_re_threshold_ties S2/S5/S8 2e-9 to 5e-9, sj_grid_re_1e6_1e8 S11-S15 2e-9), and is 10x narrower than the 1e-6 offsets of sj_re_threshold_ties, which are classified by their side. crosscheck.warning_threshold_proximity is absent in every case, so no expected warning depends on how deeply the page converges. The earlier residual concern (window narrower than the gate) is closed.

reference_decisions.decision: refused_at_import -> err; any accepted import (solved, or refused later at solve) -> ok.
reference_decisions.why: Per method.md sections 7-8 and cases.json spec_changes R3, which agree (ok/err only).

reference_decisions.decision: o = opening/100 with the 0.001 floor; 0.1 % gives o = 0.001 (Kv_eff = Kv/1000 linear, Kv x 50^-0.999 equal-percentage).
reference_decisions.why: Identical either way at the import floor; no case reaches below it.
IEC 60534-2-1 defines the Kv relation with relative density rho1/rho0 and rho0 = 1000 kg/m3 (water at 15 degC rounded); using rho_water(T) instead changes dp by < 0.1 % for 999.1 kg/m3.

reference_decisions.ambiguity: A6 pump reverse flow and runout
reference_decisions.decision: Same parabola H = H0 s^2 - a q|q| for q < 0 and q > q_runout; warned, not remodelled.
reference_decisions.why: Per method.md 5.4. concern: for q < 0 a real centrifugal pump is a turbine/brake quadrant element (Suter curves), not the parabola extrapolated; pump_against_excess_lift numbers are a property of the model, not of a real pump, and a check valve would give q = 0.

reference_decisions.ambiguity: A7 velocity head and junction losses
reference_decisions.decision: H = h + z; K multiplies the pipe own v^2/2g; no junction or exit losses.
reference_decisions.why: Standard hydraulic-grade-line network practice (EPANET, Cross); consistent with fixed nodes being large reservoirs at rest.

reference_decisions.ambiguity: A8 demand at a fixed node
reference_decisions.decision: Enters only B_n = d_n + out - in.
reference_decisions.why: A fixed-pressure node is an infinite source/sink; its demand changes the reported exchange only.

reference_decisions.decision: Expected values are converged to machine precision (continuity <= 1e-14 of flow scale). Tolerances are the global rule of the tolerance block, widened per key (case.tolerance_override_abs) to twice the first-order error the page gate (2e-9 scaled residual, h_scale/q_scale of section 6) can leave, computed from |J^-1| of the scaled mixed system at the solution.
reference_decisions.why: A reference tighter than what the stopping rule allows would fail a correctly converged page.

reference_decisions.ambiguity: A10 zero-flow snap between equal-HGL fixed nodes
reference_decisions.decision: q = 0 exactly when dH = 0 across a passive edge.
reference_decisions.why: Every passive law is odd with h(0) = 0, so q(0) = 0 is the exact root; the reference inverts q(dH) and gets 0 without a snap. No graded edge has dH = 0.

reference_decisions.ambiguity: A11 warnings by name vs id
reference_decisions.decision: Expected warnings are listed by edge id, in edge-document order within each kind, kinds in the method.md section 9 order, pump warnings one entry per pump.
reference_decisions.why: Names are unique in every case, so the mapping is a bijection.
Per method.md and Swamee & Jain (1976). Colebrook is computed only to record the scatter (crosscheck.swamee_jain_vs_colebrook of the SJ cases).

reference_decisions.ambiguity: Refusal message kinds not named in method.md
reference_decisions.decision: invalid_json for unparseable text; other kinds as named in method.md section 8.
Every well-posed case (unique root, monotone laws) is expected "solved".
reference_decisions.why: All laws are monotone so the root is unique and a damped Newton from any start reaches it; the reference reaches it in < 30 iterations. solved_capped would indicate a solver weakness, not a property of the network.
